A row is VERIFIED only when a session read the cited edition and recorded the figure as printed (verification.figure_text), the URL(s), the page or table and checked_at; its figure is set to the source's. A row still marked VERIFY was written from memory and could not be checked here: its figure is UNMEASURED and is never used for scale (macro/supply_scale.py), and verification.tried records what was attempted. A missing row is UNMEASURED, never a zero.
